name: iam:AttachRolePolicy + sts:AssumeRole
description: Attach an administrative managed policy to a target role, then assume that role to gain the elevated privileges. Requires both iam:AttachRolePolicy on the target role and sts:AssumeRole permission, with the role's trust policy allowing assumption.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must have access to attach policies to the target role
Must have permission to assume the target role

admin: Target role's trust policy must allow your principal to assume it
An AWS-managed or customer-managed policy with admin permissions must exist
lateral: Target role's trust policy must allow your principal to assume it

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

options.name: TARGET_ROLE
options.description: ARN of the IAM role to escalate and assume

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: ARN of the managed policy to attach (defaults to AdministratorAccess)

options.name: AUTO_SWITCH
options.description: Automatically switch to new identity after assuming the role
